doc.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20

title: Career run through Chris Kelly, Buddy Petit, Kid Rena, Chicago and Happy Landing
summary: He lists his bands: Chris Kelly, Buddy Petit, Kid Rena, a Chicago band, then his own band at the Happy Landing for 17 years.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: so people would have that fun huh oh plenty plenty of fun i mean at that time when i was telling you about we never had fun on the river all our fun was at milling boy out the lake people used to be out there about a thousand camps out there calling white both 50 and 60 bands out there at the same time that's how the people was out there we had the old train smokey lizzie they called it punch and train i thought that was smokey mary well i got a different smokey mary but the name of lizzie too that's well everybody have a different yeah sure well that's the way those things go all right so what i had in my life i had a lot of band training and from after i left joe nicholas band i started working with chris kelly i worked with chris kelly's band about six years left chris kelly i went and played with buddy for the team played with buddy for about four years left buddy and went to the kid renee stayed with kid renee he said about five years and left that band and went to baton rouge two joints and from that i went directly chicago and played with dance with who dance dance dance a fellow called dance he had a big band 12 pieces augustine well that's all his name dance that's joe dance his name was well he's dead that fellow's dead so that's why i left there you see after he died after he taken sick they had other guy taken over one of the oh well he didn't like us new orleans 60s you know what i mean and that made me just left the band i came back to new orleans that's where i started out with the saxophone what saxophone tenor and alto played both of them and i came to new orleans played around with a lot of bands in new orleans played a long while at the happy landing whose band was that well that's my band at the happy landing at the happy landing club i stayed out up to work back there for 17 years i just got tired playing at night and i just thought i'd quit
